result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. One clear visual defect was found: the second card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned relative to its neighbors, breaking the row's alignment.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted down by roughly 25–30px compared to the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol…' cards. Its image top edge, title, and delivery price all sit lower than the adjacent cards, making the row look staggered/broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel cards share the same top alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start with consistent card height/margins) and remove any extra top margin or offset applied to that card.
